continuity: Taekyung is asleep in the Murim world while his consciousness is in the realm of immortals; Jeok Cheongang stays beside him until he wakes.
The coalition army of more than two hundred thousand is crossing the Taklamakan Desert toward Tianshan, and Jeok intends to protect Taekyung there.
The Grand Mage has been reborn through the Lord of Heaven’s grace and felt a wave that the Lord connects to the heavens opening again; its cause and significance remain unexplained.
plot: Jeok Cheongang keeps watch over the sleeping Jin Taekyung, whose consciousness has gone to the realm of immortals. Taekyung has promised to return after investigating a suspected crisis there. As the coalition army marches across the Taklamakan Desert toward Tianshan, Jeok resolves to stay beside him and protect him; the Slaughter Saint and others remain nearby, and Jeok takes comfort in seeing how many people care for his Disciple. Dark clouds gather over the desert.

Elsewhere, a shadow awakens in a sealed chamber after briefly losing consciousness, kills a subordinate for questioning the truth, and seeks answers from the Lord of Heaven. The Lord says the shadow—now revealed to be the Grand Mage—must have felt a wave because root and branch are one, and the Grand Mage was reborn through the Lord’s grace. A faint green light rises; the Lord caresses jade and declares that the heavens have opened once again.
translation_decisions: Render 仙界 as “realm of immortals,” 塔克拉玛干 as “Taklamakan Desert,” and 汗血寶馬 as “sweat-blood horse.”

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Secretive, sharp-eyed, gruff, and dryly teasing, he fears water and freely follows his own path rather than pursuing grand causes; he cares about protecting those he still has.
